notes.title: Beta 1.2.6
notes.notes: [p][b]Skeleton added.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A new enemy with a stick in hand and the same speed as the player.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bone added.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A hard organ. Obtained from skeletons.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 1.2.5
notes.notes:
[b]The ruined building was added.[/b]

A rundown shelter made of wood and logs. It could be useful if repaired.

notes.title: Beta 1.2.4
notes.notes:
[b]Added hunger value[/b]

If the hunger value is above a certain value, your health will increase.

notes.title: Beta 1.2.3
notes.notes:
[b]String added.[/b]

It can be used in fabric making. It is obtained from sheep.

[b]Fabric added.[/b]

It is obtained from strings. It is used in making clothes.

[b]Added clothes[/b]

It helps to keep body temperature stable when worn.

[u]The quantities of some items have been changed.[/u]

notes.title: Beta 1.2.2
notes.notes:
[b]Sheep added[/b]

This creature, which appears during the day and at noon, can drop meat when it dies.

notes.title: Beta 1.2.1
notes.notes:
[b]Coal added.[/b]

It is used as fuel. It is obtained by breaking the coal ore with a pickaxe.

[b]Mud added[/b]

It is obtained by digging up mud areas by pressing the left mouse button.

[b]Sand added[/b]

It is obtained by digging up sand areas by pressing the left mouse button.

[b]Glass material added[/b]

It can be obtained by melting sand.

[b]The glass structure was added.[/b]

Glass structure can be made with three glass materials.

[b]Brick added[/b]

It can be obtained by heating the mud material.

[b]Brick structure added[/b]

it can be made with 6 bricks.

[b]The campfire's fuel capacity has been increased.[/b]

[b]Rock added[/b]

Small rocks can be obtained by digging large rocks with a pickaxe.

[b]Coal ore added[/b]

You can extract coal and rock by digging coal ore with a pickaxe.

notes.title: Beta 1.2.0
notes.notes:
The UI system has been changed, simplified.

[b]New Slot keys:[/b]

Right mouse button:
Use to item.

Left mouse button:
Move the item to another slot.

Shift + Right mouse button:
Open using panel.

Q: 
Drop to item.

Shift + Left mouse button:
Taking items from slots that are not included in the inventory into the inventory.

[b]Physics has been added to the pickaxe item.[/b]

notes.title: Beta 1.1.9
notes.notes:
[b]Added bed[/b]

Now you can make a bed to sleep at night.

[b]3 seconds protection[/b]

When you start the game, you will be immortal for 3 seconds.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.8
notes.notes:
[b]Snow bowl item added[/b]

If you press the interaction button on the snow surface while you have a bowl in your hand, you will fill the snow into the bowl.

[b]Half wooden plate added.[/b]

A new plate half the size of the wooden plate.

[b]Fence added.[/b]

Fence structure added.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.7
notes.notes:
Increased campfire fuel capacity.

[b]Added bowl item[/b]

You can store and use water with the bowl.

Added blood effect.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.6
notes.notes:
[b]Cheat system[/b]

We added cheats to make the testing process of the game easier.
You can open the command entry tab by pressing the F1 key.

Cheats:

[u]give {item id}[/u] gives you that id's item.

[u]temp[/u]  Turns off/on temperature related variables.

[u]water {count}[/u] Adjusts your thirst to the value you specify.

[u]health {count}[/u] Adjusts your health to the value you specify.

[u]energy {count}[/u] Adjusts your energy to the value you specify.

[b]Logs:[/b]

Wood can now be used as fuel.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.5
notes.notes:
[b]Log:[/b]

The material that comes out when we cut down trees.

It can be used in building construction and obtaining wood.

[b]New Sounds[/b]

Added zombie grunting and cafting sounds

[b]Hud on/off button[/b]

You can now turn the Hud display on or off from the settings.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.4
notes.notes:
[b]A new map has been added.[/b]

GreatIsland: much larger than previous maps.

[b]An adjustment has been made regarding burning[/b]

There will no longer be any burning sensation when you enter the water.

[b]New sound effect added.[/b]

Sound will now be heard when waving a weapon in vain.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.3
notes.notes:
[b]The temperature system has been changed[/b]

Any temperature change will now occur slowly.
There is a bar at the bottom of the screen and when this bar is full, you will lose your health.

[b]Fixed color error in the text below the crosshair[/b]

Objects that do not require any tools to break will now appear white in the text.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[b]-The bug during the attack has been fixed.[/b]

You will no longer run out of energy when you press the attack button before the attack animation ends.

[b]Color feature has been added to the text under the crosshair.[/b]

If it is white, the structure you are looking at can be broken with the item we have. 
If it is red, it cannot be broken. 
If it is yellow, the item it will drop depends on the type of item you use.

[b]Added wooden pillar[/b]

Added wooden pillar as structure.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[b]-Fall damage added[/b]
If you fall from a certain height, you will take fall damage.

[b]-Flame effect added[/b]
Living things on something that burns burn.

[b]-Bush seed added[/b]
You can grow new bushes by planting the seeds from the bushes.

[b]-Door added[/b]
You can now build a door.

[b]-Construction system has been renewed[/b]
Building materials can stick together better.

notes.title: Beta 1.1 update
notes.notes:
Beta 1.1 update

The graphics engine was switched to Unreal Engine 5.

Temperature system and maps updated

Save system has been updated.
